title: Spec check skips a vendor marked out
lead: *Proposed.* The spec check's row chain (`specChain`, `internal/daemon/speccheck.go:186`) skips a row whose vendor is marked out, as run admission does, and a spec-check role that exits with the out class marks its vendor out and moves to the next row.
findings_note: 2026-11-16 20:23: with grok marked out (`ork vendor out grok --until 21:22`), `ork run ork S359` and `ork run ork S179` failed at once with "spec check failed: spec-check (grok grok-4.7 medium) exited unclassified": the spec check still ran its first row (r24, grok). The orchestrator moved ork's spec-check rows to r16,r24 by hand to get past it.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: *Proposed.* The spec check runs before every start, so one out vendor in its first row blocks every run of the project.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/daemon/speccheck.go:188-269` (`specChain`: skip out vendors)
- `internal/engine/speccheck.go:381-409` (`runSpecCheckOnce`: mark the vendor out and fall back on an out exit)
- `internal/engine/vendors.go` (`Vendors.Lookup`, the out lookup)
- `internal/daemon/speccheck_test.go`
- `docs/design.md`
- `CHANGELOG.md`

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `TestSpecChainSkipsAVendorMarkedOut`: rows r24 (grok) then r16 (claude) with grok marked out run the spec check on r16.
- `TestSpecCheckFallsBackOnAnOutExit`: a fake grok spec-check role that exits out-of-credits (or rate-limited) marks grok out and the check finishes on r16.
- `TestSpecCheckSkipsTheOutVendorsOtherRowsAfterARateLimit`: rows r24 and r25 (grok) then r16: after a rate-limited r24 the check runs r16, not r25.
- `TestSpecCheckAllRowsOutRefuses`: every row out refuses with a message that names the vendors and their end times.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Red tests above.
2. Code.
3. Docs: `docs/design.md`. CHANGELOG.md: one bullet under `## Unreleased`.
